name: CO2Budget
description:
Closes the global carbon cycle by integrating emissions and uptakes to
update the atmospheric CO2 concentration.
The concentration changes as

$$\frac{dC}{dt} = \frac{E_{fossil} + E_{CH_4\,ox} - F_{land} - F_{ocean}}{\text{GtC\_per\_ppm}}$$

# What This Component Does

1. Sums fossil emissions with CO2 from fossil CH4 oxidation
2. Subtracts the net land and ocean uptake
3. Updates atmospheric CO2 concentration for the next step
4. Calculates the airborne fraction of the fossil sources

Biosphere CO2 emissions are part of the net atmosphere to land flux, as in MAGICC7,
because deforestation removes carbon from the land pools.

# Inputs

- `Ocean Carbon Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2` (ppm), only with the `ocean_end_of_year` parameter:
  concentration after the ocean's last substep
- `Emissions|CO2|Permafrost` (GtC/yr), only with the `include_permafrost` parameter
- `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2` (ppm), only with the `concentration_switch_year` parameter

# Differences from MAGICC7

- **Monthly integration in the ocean**: in MAGICC7, atmospheric CO2 evolves over
  the ocean's substeps, and the concentration it ends the year on becomes next year's.
  `ocean_end_of_year` takes that value from `OceanCarbon`. Without it, the annual sum
  in [`CO2Budget::solve_budget`] differs from it only by rounding.
- **No concentration cap**: MAGICC7 can cap CO2 concentration. Not implemented.
- **No inverse fossil emissions**: before `concentration_switch_year` the
  concentration follows `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2` and
  `Net Emissions|CO2` is the implied net source, but fossil emissions are not inverted.

inputs.name: Emissions|CO2|Fossil
inputs.description: Fossil CO2 emissions over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|CO2|CH4 Oxidation
inputs.description: CO2 from oxidised fossil CH4 over the step

inputs.name: Net Atmosphere to Land Flux|CO2
inputs.description: Net atmosphere to land flux over the step, positive for uptake and including Biosphere CO2 emissions

inputs.name: Net Atmosphere to Ocean Flux|CO2
inputs.description: Net atmosphere to ocean flux over the step, positive for uptake

outputs.name: Net Emissions|CO2
outputs.description: Net CO2 emissions to the atmosphere over the step

outputs.name: Airborne Fraction|CO2
outputs.description: Fraction of the step's fossil sources that stays in the atmosphere

states.name: Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2
states.description: Atmospheric CO2 concentration at the end of the step

parameters.name: gtc_per_ppm
parameters.description:
Conversion factor from atmospheric carbon mass to CO2 concentration

unit: GtC/ppm

Default: 2.123 GtC/ppm

parameters.name: co2_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial CO2 concentration (MAGICC7 `CO2_PREINDCO2CONC`).

unit: ppm

The component does not use it yet.

Default: 278.0 ppm
MAGICC7: CO2_PREINDCO2CONC

parameters.name: include_permafrost
parameters.description:
Add `Emissions|CO2|Permafrost` from the `Permafrost` component to the sources (MAGICC7 `PF_APPLY`)

Default: false

parameters.name: concentration_switch_year
parameters.description:
Last year of concentrations prescribed by `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2`
(MAGICC7 `CO2_SWITCHFROMCONC2EMIS_YEAR`).

unit: yr

`None` calculates concentrations from emissions throughout.

parameters.name: ocean_end_of_year
parameters.description:
Take next year's concentration from `Ocean Carbon Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2`.

`OceanCarbon` integrates it over its substeps, as MAGICC7 does.

Default: false
